title: Retire the external C:\github\Personal\TermAl-wt-* worktree roots; TermAl worktrees live only inside the repository
outcome: No TermAl worktree root exists outside the repository. Clean roots for landed work are removed by the machine-safety procedure with their evidence archived, and dirty roots are kept, or recreated as Git-managed worktrees under .tmp, until their owners decide.
acceptance: Each removed root was clean, its HEAD was in master, no session had it as cwd, its review-runs were archived to .evidence/<wt>/ with a verified count and hashes, its ui/node_modules link was unlinked without being followed, master's ui/node_modules was verified intact, and it was removed with `git worktree remove` without --force; each removal is recorded with names, counts and bytes.
Every dirty root is either kept with its owner and reason recorded, or recreated as a verified Git-managed worktree under .tmp before its old root is removed; no directory is raw-moved.
